source.read_policy: git object at pinned commit; never infer from a dirty upstream worktree

milestone_1_policy.window_policy: maintain aspect ratio; pillarbox widescreen windows
milestone_1_policy.hud_policy: source-style 640x480 HUD with integer scaling and no v1 widescreen reflow
milestone_1_policy.enhanced_replacement_art: deferred; optional owner high-resolution banks only

source_anchors.observed_contract: pinned regression profile uses 640x480 window/game resolution, aspect maintenance, source assets, sky, reflections, and dynamic lighting
allocates resolution-bounded indexed buffers and three-plane blur padding; constructor/destructor own the render history lifetime
viewport dimensions feed projection and terrain traversal; viewDistanceScale expands tile lattice and scales fog/cutoff quadratically
indexed sky is rendered into the current viewport; the pinned branch selects the base 256 bank or a 1024 high-resolution bank when the high-resolution texture-size flag is active
terrain and particles use a painter-style traversal with viewport clipping and indexed texture reads; exact ordering must be preserved while the buffer dimensions become profile parameters
billboard orientation, sprite projection, clipping, and palette-index writes are resolution-aware consumers of the same viewport and screen stride
UI scale and pointer mapping use the active screen dimensions; source 640-wide HUD geometry is centered inside the current surface
renderer selection and screen dimensions are chosen before the game render object is constructed; no mid-frame renderer-family switch is part of the Classic HD contract
high-resolution owner banks are optional capabilities; missing banks must fall back to the original indexed owner banks without changing gameplay

pipeline_contract.output: validated profile and owned indexed resources
pipeline_contract.test: reject non-4:3 internal profiles and missing required profile fields

pipeline_contract.output: R8 world buffer with stride equal to width plus isolated history buffers
pipeline_contract.test: for each profile, assert buffer length equals width*height and history reset clears all planes

pipeline_contract.output: indexed sky plane at profile dimensions
pipeline_contract.filtering: source-shaped integer lookup; no RGB interpolation claim
pipeline_contract.test: same camera and bank produce identical bytes; 1024 bank selection is visible in a synthetic pattern

pipeline_contract.clipping: viewport and source raster clipping must be explicit
pipeline_contract.test: profile scaling changes only presentation buffers and preserves command/state hashes
actor submission order and clipping are stable across repeated renders

pipeline_contract.history: reset on new presentation session, level reset, and profile change; never leak between modes
pipeline_contract.test: first frame after each reset is independent of the prior profile and mode

pipeline_contract.output: 4:3 fitted window with integer source-style HUD
pipeline_contract.filtering: integer HUD scale; window fit is separate from internal game resolution
pipeline_contract.test: widescreen window changes only pillarbox rectangle and pointer transform in v1

unresolved_or_fail_closed: exact per-stage reflection and blur ownership must be isolated before claiming Classic HD pixel parity
widescreen world expansion is deferred from milestone 1
temporal history equivalence across profile changes is not assumed
optional 4x sprite-bank coverage must be capability-tested before enabling
any unsupported renderer branch fails closed instead of silently substituting a final-frame upscale
